With Immortal Grapple, only hand strikes may be used. How does this
effect equipment like Sengir Dagger or bang Nahk, or other weapons that
add to hand damage.

If I have an Inner Circle or Justicar ready and one of my vampires commits
diablerie can I play Absolution of the Diabolist?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
rai...@mich.com wrote:
>
> With Immortal Grapple, only hand strikes may be used. How does this
> effect equipment like Sengir Dagger or bang Nahk, or other weapons that
> add to hand damage.

Striking with a weapon produces a weapon strike, not a hand strike.
As such, weapons cannot be used under Immortal Grapple.

> If I have an Inner Circle or Justicar ready and one of my vampires commits
> diablerie can I play Absolution of the Diabolist?

?
Yes, if a Blood Hunt is called. (card text).
